title: Landed at 3pm. Under the bats by sunset.
why: POV trip story from a real Google review (Raelynn C., Oct 2025) for visitors who think a bat tour needs advance planning.
hook_options: She booked the bat tour from the airport
No plan at 3pm. Bats overhead by dusk.
The best last-minute call of her Austin trip
caption: Raelynn C. landed in Austin at 3pm on a Friday and booked the bat tour last minute. Her review: 'It was the best decision!' The colony is here until early November. Same-day seats happen. #austinbats #ladybirdlake #austinkayaktours #visitaustin

slides.headline: Landed at 3pm. Under the bats by sunset.
slides.body: Raelynn C. flew into Austin and booked the bat tour last minute. Here's how that evening went, in her words.

slides.headline: Plane lands. No plan yet.
slides.body: Her review: she "got into Austin at 3pm last Friday and decided at the last minute to grab a ticket."

slides.headline: Check in, life vest, quick paddle lesson
slides.body: Guided sunset bat tours launch from 200 E Riverside Dr. About two hours, kayak and gear included. No experience needed.

slides.headline: The skyline shows up first
slides.body: "Seeing the skyline from the water" made her list. Most visitors only ever see it from a sidewalk.

slides.headline: Guides park you beside Congress Avenue Bridge
slides.body: Up to 1.5 million Mexican free-tailed bats roost underneath. Guides cover bats and Austin history while the light drops.

slides.headline: The bats run on their own clock
slides.body: Some nights they pour out right at sunset. Some nights they're late. Wild animals, never guaranteed.

slides.headline: The colony comes out overhead
slides.body: Her verdict on the whole evening, a few hours after landing: "It was the best decision!"

slides.headline: When the bats ran late, the tour stayed out
slides.body: Becky K.: the bats "weren't coming out right away" so her guide kept the group out "as long as we wanted."

slides.headline: You don't need a plan. You need two hours.
slides.body: Same-day booking works when seats are open. The colony stays until early November, then it's gone until spring.

slides.kicker: Send this to whoever just landed
slides.headline: Your first Austin sunset, on the water
slides.body: Sunset bat tours on Lady Bird Lake. Book at austinkayaktours.com.
